title: Please don’t buy Google’s wildly overpriced Pixel 11 Clear Case
summary: While the left and right sides of Spigen’s case do have a little more flex than Google’s (something that won’t matter once it’s on the phone), Google’s case leaves the entire bottom gap effectively unprotected.
